column8: ["Give the broad ivory glaze more character: pooled glaze, fine crazing and selective scuffs would enrich the largely uniform surface.","Differentiate the socket materials with sharper brass glints, dark tarnished recesses and matte rubber lips; the rings currently feel softly painted into the ceramic.","Strengthen the outer rim with a deeper underside shadow and selective chipped highlights to make the slab feel heavier.","Add a few distinctive crafted fittings or repairs to break the repeated socket treatment and give the machine an authored personality."]
